prefer.description: Specifies the spelling to enforce for each aliased property. Properties left unspecified keep their default, which is the canonical spelling.

bundleDependencies.description: The spelling to enforce (`bundleDependencies` or `bundledDependencies`), `true` for the canonical one, or `false` to only report using both spellings at once.

license.description: The spelling to enforce (`license` or `licence`), `true` for the canonical one, or `false` to only report using both spellings at once.
